status.label: Missing
status.description: Shown for a required document with no link. Computed from configuration, never stored.

tier.label: Tier 1
tier.description: Personal or team use. Reads, or changes only the person's own items. No sensitive data.

tier.label: Tier 2
tier.description: Department use. Changes shared data as the signed-in person, or touches internal data.

tier.label: Tier 3
tier.description: Acts under its own identity, touches restricted data, reaches the whole organization or outside users, or executes changes as an agent.

tier-question.label: Data change
tier-question.helpText: Example: a flow that updates customer records under its own identity is tier 3.

answerOptions.label: Reads only
answerOptions.answerText: Reads only, or changes only the person's own items

answerOptions.label: As the user
answerOptions.answerText: Changes shared business data as the signed-in person

answerOptions.label: Own identity
answerOptions.answerText: Changes data under its own identity, or in a system of record

answerOptions.label: Restricted
answerOptions.answerText: Personal, financial, regulated or otherwise restricted data

answerOptions.label: Small team
answerOptions.answerText: The builder or a small team

answerOptions.label: Organization or outside
answerOptions.answerText: The whole organization, or anyone outside it

tier-question.label: Agent autonomy
tier-question.questionText: Does an agent act on its own?

answerOptions.label: Assists
answerOptions.answerText: No, it assists a person who stays in the loop

answerOptions.label: Routes
answerOptions.answerText: It answers or routes, a person acts

tier-question.label: Failure impact
tier-question.questionText: What happens if it fails for a day?

answerOptions.label: Business hit
answerOptions.answerText: Revenue, compliance or trust is hit

documentation-requirement.label: Every application has a wiki page

review-type.label: Access check
review-type.description: Links to Entra access review results; never reruns them.

role.label: Maker
role.duties: Builds in approved environments and records links.

role.label: Data owner
role.duties: Decides data use for a data area.

role.label: Architect
role.duties: Reviews designs and grants exceptions to standards.

role.label: Change manager
role.duties: Runs the change schedule; authorizes tier 3 changes and emergencies.

role.label: Change board
role.duties: Decides exceptions about changes, and windows that cover several applications, as a group.

role.label: PMO
role.duties: Scores demand and runs portfolio reviews.

role.label: AI lead
role.duties: Keeps the AI guidelines, is consulted on agent autonomy, decides on agents Microsoft flags.

role.label: Security reviewer
role.duties: Runs security reviews and agrees agent autonomy levels.

role.label: Platform admin
role.duties: Triages intake, confirms tiers, runs the gap check.

role.label: Auditor
role.duties: Reads everything, including audit entries, and changes nothing.

role.label: Reader
role.duties: Reads the register, decisions and the change schedule. No audit entries, no restricted columns. Never writes.

role.label: Deployment recorder
role.duties: Held by pipeline identities through a workload grant. Writes deployment records.

role.label: Approval writer
role.duties: Held by the approval runner through a workload grant. Writes the person's answer on an approval record; never decides.

approval-rule.label: Change manager authorizes a tier 3 emergency
Change board decides an exception about a standard change
Change board decides an exception about a normal change

guideline.label: G1 Keep one register
guideline.rule: Keep one register of business applications; an inventory is not a catalog.

guideline.label: G2 Name the owners
guideline.rule: Every app names business, technical and data owners.

guideline.label: G17 No AI approves
guideline.rule: No AI approves its own work, or anyone's.

separation-rule.label: Deployer is not the only approver
